notes.title: The Creature Collector Fest has begun!
notes.content:
Our beloved subgenre is finally getting its long-deserved recognition! I know, I know, we're more into things than creatures around here, but hey, as long as the collector part is there, right?

We're preparing some exciting surprises for you, and in the meantime, check out this festival full of incredible creature collector games! Don't forget to also tell your friends about this intriguing soul-collecting roguelite in the making!

Have an amazing week of... collecting games about collecting!

notes.title: Soul Shuffler taking part in the Turn-Based Carnival 2024!
notes.content:
If you're a fan of games with various turn-based systems, make sure to check out this amazing Steam event hosted by Acram Digital called Turn-Based Carnival!

It's an entire treasure trove of both released projects you can buy with discounts and coming soon games to wishlist and follow!

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Acram/sale/turn-basedcarnival2024
